page_title: BAY 2-0 FRE | Bayern Munich v Freiburg 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
90+6' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+5' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich). The referee gives a penalty to Freiburg after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
90+5' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) will take a corner kick.
90+5' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Now Freiburg have a corner.
90+2' Florian Muller leaps to intercept the corner kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).

90+2' A through ball from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to reach Konrad Laimer as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Konrad Laimer could have got into a promising position. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dayot Upamecano leaves the pitch and Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) comes on.
90' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
89' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) tested Manuel Neuer with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
88' A long ball forward to Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is intercepted.
81' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) replaces Lukas Kubler.
81' It's time for a substitution. Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) comes on in place of Christian Gunter.

78' 2 - 0 Serge Gnabry sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:0.
75' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
75' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Here comes a substitution. Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Aleksandar Pavlovic.
74' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Jamal Musiala will be replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
72' Substitution. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) on for Patrick Osterhage.
70' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
66' It looks like Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) saw red with that tackle. Christian Dingert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
64' A cross into the box from Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is cleared.
63' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Merlin Rohl departs the field of play to be replaced by Eren Dinkci (Freiburg).
62' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
61' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

61' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Manuel Neuer stops the ball from going inside right post. Freiburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
59' Substitution. Michael Olise is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
59' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) replacing Mathys Tel.

57' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) looks like he will send a long ball into the penalty box from the free kick and it is a good chance for one of his teammates who is good in the air to get on the scoresheet.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
50' A pass by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
48' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
45+2' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) tries to find Junior Adamu, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
42' Harry Kane receives a sweet cross inside the box from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.

41' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
40' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Florian Muller to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
37' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bayern Munich!

36' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bayern Munich players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Christian Dingert interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
36' That looked a certain handball by Christian Gunter (Freiburg) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
31' The foul by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Christian Dingert.
31' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
29' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
27' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
26' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) tries to find Mathys Tel, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
24' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
21' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Florian Muller stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
20' Bayern Munich take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
20' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to Bayern Munich.
19' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) passes the ball onto Jamal Musiala, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
17' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) tries to find Serge Gnabry, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
15' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
15' Rough tackle by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

13' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Christian Dingert saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Freiburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
10' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) plays a one-two with Harry Kane, but the move breaks down.
8' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
7' The ball is cleared after Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Christian Dingert was nominated as the referee for this game.
